root_causes.description: High volume of AR exceptions ($2.6M) due to incomplete or inaccurate data entry in accounts receivable processes.
Bank duplicate records (13 instances) caused by insufficient validation checks during reconciliation.
root_causes.financial_impact: Potential misstatement risk in cash balances.

remediations.action: Implement stricter validation rules and automated checks for AR data entry to ensure completeness and accuracy.
remediations.success_criteria: Reduction in AR exceptions by 90% in the next financial close cycle.

remediations.action: Enhance bank reconciliation workflows with duplicate detection algorithms and manual review checkpoints.
remediations.success_criteria: Elimination of duplicate bank records in the next financial close cycle.
